## Functions

#### Sigmoidal Generation

```{r}
F_test_single<-function(time_param,reps,noise_level,max,slopeParam,midpoint,h0){
reps <- reps
time  <- rep(seq(0, 300, by = time_param), times = reps)
noise_level <- noise_level
noise <- rnorm(length(time), 0, noise_level)
reject_sigmoid<-0
reject_double<-0



intensity_raw <- (sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
  x          = time,
  maximum    = max,
  slopeParam = slopeParam,
  midPoint   = midpoint,
  h0=h0
))

intensity<-intensity_raw+noise

dataInput <- data.frame(time = time, intensity = intensity)
normalizedInput <- normalizeData(dataInput = dataInput)

group_summary<-dataInput|>
  group_by(time)|>
  summarize(average = mean(intensity),.groups = 'drop')


sigmoidalModel <- tryCatch(new_multipleFitFunction_h0(dataInput = normalizedInput,
                                          model = "sigmoidal",
                                          n_runs_min = 20,
                                          n_runs_max = 500,
                                          showDetails = FALSE),error=function(e) NULL)



sigmoidalModel <- tryCatch(parameterCalculation_h0(sigmoidalModel),error=function(e) NULL)

doubleSigmoidalModel<-tryCatch(new_multipleFitFunction_h0(dataInput = normalizedInput,
                                          model = "doublesigmoidal",
                                          n_runs_min = 20,
                                          n_runs_max = 500,
                                          showDetails = FALSE),error=function(e) NULL)

doubleSigmoidalModel <- tryCatch(parameterCalculation_h0(doubleSigmoidalModel),error=function(e) NULL)

if(!is.null(sigmoidalModel)){
  sigmoid_fitted_values <- sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = dataInput$time,
    maximum = sigmoidalModel$maximum_Estimate,

    slopeParam =
      sigmoidalModel$slopeParam_Estimate,

    midPoint =
      sigmoidalModel$midPoint_Estimate,

    h0=sigmoidalModel$h0_Estimate
  )





  sigmoid_residuals <-
    dataInput$intensity - sigmoid_fitted_values

  sigmoid_df<-length(time)-4



flat_line<-mean(dataInput$intensity)

flat_residuals<-dataInput$intensity-flat_line

flat_df<-length(time)-1

Flat_stat<-(((sum(flat_residuals^2)-sum(sigmoid_residuals^2)))/(flat_df-sigmoid_df))/(sum(sigmoid_residuals^2)/sigmoid_df)


  

F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value<-pf(Flat_stat,flat_df-sigmoid_df,sigmoid_df,lower.tail=FALSE)






if(F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value>0.01){
  reject_sigmoid<-1
}


# Second F-test

total_error<-sum(sigmoid_residuals^2)

avg_at_time_point<- data.frame(dataInput)|>
                        group_by(time)|>
                        mutate(average=mean(intensity))

pure_error<-sum(ave(
    dataInput$intensity,
    dataInput$time,
    FUN = function(x) (x - mean(x))^2))


group_summary<-dataInput|>
  group_by(time)|>
  summarize(average = mean(intensity),.groups = 'drop')

  sigmoid_fitted_unique <- sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = group_summary$time,
    maximum = sigmoidalModel$maximum_Estimate,
    slopeParam = sigmoidalModel$slopeParam_Estimate,
    midPoint = sigmoidalModel$midPoint_Estimate,
    h0 = sigmoidalModel$h0_Estimate
  )


  lack_of_fit_2<-reps*sum((sigmoid_fitted_unique-group_summary$average)^2)


  lack_of_fit_df<- length(group_summary$time)-4 
  pure_error_df<- length(time)-length(group_summary$time)

  lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat<-(lack_of_fit_2/lack_of_fit_df)/(pure_error/pure_error_df)
  lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<-pf(lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat,lack_of_fit_df,pure_error_df, lower.tail=FALSE)




if(lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<0.05){
  reject_sigmoid<-1
}
       sigmoidalModel.AIC<-sigmoidalModel$AIC
}

else{
  maximum_Estimate<-NA
slopeParam_Estimate<-NA
midPoint_Estimate<-NA
h0_Estimate<-NA
Flat_stat<-NA
F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value<-NA
sigmoidalModel.AIC<-NA
lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat<-NA
lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<-NA
reject_sigmoid<-1
}

if(!is.null(doubleSigmoidalModel)){
ds_fitted_values<-doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = dataInput$time,
    maximum = doubleSigmoidalModel$maximum_y,

    slope1Param =
      doubleSigmoidalModel$slope1Param_Estimate,

    midPoint1Param =
      doubleSigmoidalModel$midPoint1Param_Estimate,

    slope2Param=doubleSigmoidalModel$slope2Param_Estimate,

    midPointDistanceParam = doubleSigmoidalModel$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate,

    finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio=doubleSigmoidalModel$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate,

    h0=doubleSigmoidalModel$startPoint_y)

ds_residuals<-dataInput$intensity-ds_fitted_values

ds_df<-length(time)-7

flat_line<-mean(dataInput$intensity)

flat_residuals<-dataInput$intensity-flat_line

flat_df<-length(time)-1

Flat_ds_stat<-(((sum(flat_residuals^2)-sum(ds_residuals^2)))/(flat_df-ds_df))/(sum(ds_residuals^2)/ds_df)
  

F_Flat_ds_p_value<-pf(Flat_ds_stat,flat_df-ds_df,ds_df,lower.tail=FALSE)


if(F_Flat_ds_p_value>0.01){
  reject_double<-1
}

# Second F-test

total_error_ds<-sum(ds_residuals^2)

avg_at_time_point_ds<- data.frame(dataInput)|>
                        group_by(time)|>
                        mutate(average=mean(intensity))

pure_error_ds<-sum(ave(
    dataInput$intensity,
    dataInput$time,
    FUN = function(x) (x - mean(x))^2))


  ds_fitted_unique <- doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = group_summary$time,
    maximum = doubleSigmoidalModel$maximum_Estimate,
    slope1Param = doubleSigmoidalModel$slope1Param_Estimate,
    midPoint1Param = doubleSigmoidalModel$midPoint1Param_Estimate,
    slope2Param = doubleSigmoidalModel$slope2Param_Estimate,
    midPointDistanceParam = doubleSigmoidalModel$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate,
    finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio = doubleSigmoidalModel$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate,
    h0 = doubleSigmoidalModel$h0_Estimate
  )


  lack_of_fit_2_ds<-reps*sum((ds_fitted_unique-group_summary$average)^2)

  lack_of_fit_df_ds<-length(group_summary$time)-7
  pure_error_df_ds<-length(time)-length(group_summary$time)

  lack_of_fit_ds_stat<-(lack_of_fit_2_ds/lack_of_fit_df_ds)/(pure_error_ds/ pure_error_df_ds)
  lack_of_fit_ds_p_value <- pf(lack_of_fit_ds_stat, lack_of_fit_df_ds, pure_error_df_ds, lower.tail = FALSE)


if(lack_of_fit_ds_p_value<0.05){
  reject_double<-1
}
doubleSigmoidalModel.AIC<-doubleSigmoidalModel$AIC

}

else{
Flat_ds_stat<-NA
F_Flat_ds_p_value<-NA
lack_of_fit_ds_stat<-NA
lack_of_fit_ds_p_value<-NA
doubleSigmoidalModel.AIC<-NA
reject_double<-1  
}




return(data.frame(time_param,reps,noise_level,max,slopeParam,midpoint,h0,
Flat_stat,
F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value,
Flat_ds_stat,
F_Flat_ds_p_value,
sigmoidalModel.AIC,
lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat,
lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value,
lack_of_fit_ds_stat,
lack_of_fit_ds_p_value,
doubleSigmoidalModel.AIC,reject_sigmoid,reject_double))}

```

intensity<-intensity_raw+noise

    h0 = sigmoidalModel$h0_Estimate
  )

  lack_of_fit_2<-reps*sum((sigmoid_fitted_unique-group_summary$average)^2)

  pure_error_df<-length(time)-length(group_summary$time)

  lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<-pf(lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat, lack_of_fit_df, pure_error_df, lower.tail = FALSE)

max_estimate<-sigmoidalModel$maximum_Estimate
slopeParam_estimate<-sigmoidalModel$slopeParam_Estimate
midpoint_estimate<-sigmoidalModel$midPoint_Estimate
ho_estimate<-sigmoidalModel$h0_Estimate


       sigmoidalModel.AIC<-sigmoidalModel$AIC

 maximum_estimate<-NA

#### Quadratic Generation

```{r}
F_test_quadratic<-function(time_param,reps,noise_level){
reps <- reps
time  <- rep(seq(0, 300, by = time_param), times = reps)
noise_level <- noise_level
noise <- rnorm(length(time), 0, noise_level)
reject_sigmoid<-0
reject_double<-0



intensity_raw <- (time-150)^2 +60000

intensity<-intensity_raw+noise

dataInput <- data.frame(time = time, intensity = intensity)
normalizedInput <- normalizeData(dataInput = dataInput)

group_summary<-dataInput|>
  group_by(time)|>
  summarize(average = mean(intensity),.groups = 'drop')


sigmoidalModel <- tryCatch(new_multipleFitFunction_h0(dataInput = normalizedInput,
                                          model = "sigmoidal",
                                          n_runs_min = 20,
                                          n_runs_max = 500,
                                          showDetails = FALSE),error=function(e) NULL)



sigmoidalModel <- tryCatch(parameterCalculation_h0(sigmoidalModel),error=function(e) NULL)

doubleSigmoidalModel<-tryCatch(new_multipleFitFunction_h0(dataInput = normalizedInput,
                                          model = "doublesigmoidal",
                                          n_runs_min = 20,
                                          n_runs_max = 500,
                                          showDetails = FALSE),error=function(e) NULL)

doubleSigmoidalModel <- tryCatch(parameterCalculation_h0(doubleSigmoidalModel),error=function(e) NULL)

if(!is.null(sigmoidalModel)){
  sigmoid_fitted_values <- sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = dataInput$time,
    maximum = sigmoidalModel$maximum_Estimate,

    slopeParam =
      sigmoidalModel$slopeParam_Estimate,

    midPoint =
      sigmoidalModel$midPoint_Estimate,

    h0=sigmoidalModel$h0_Estimate
  )





  sigmoid_residuals <-
    dataInput$intensity - sigmoid_fitted_values

  sigmoid_df<-length(time)-4



flat_line<-mean(dataInput$intensity)

flat_residuals<-dataInput$intensity-flat_line

flat_df<-length(time)-1

Flat_stat<-(((sum(flat_residuals^2)-sum(sigmoid_residuals^2)))/(flat_df-sigmoid_df))/(sum(sigmoid_residuals^2)/sigmoid_df)


  

F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value<-pf(Flat_stat,flat_df-sigmoid_df,sigmoid_df,lower.tail=FALSE)






if(F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value>0.01){
  reject_sigmoid<-1
}


# Second F-test

total_error<-sum(sigmoid_residuals^2)

avg_at_time_point<- data.frame(dataInput)|>
                        group_by(time)|>
                        mutate(average=mean(intensity))

pure_error<-sum(ave(
    dataInput$intensity,
    dataInput$time,
    FUN = function(x) (x - mean(x))^2))


group_summary<-dataInput|>
  group_by(time)|>
  summarize(average = mean(intensity),.groups = 'drop')

  sigmoid_fitted_unique <- sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = group_summary$time,
    maximum = sigmoidalModel$maximum_Estimate,
    slopeParam = sigmoidalModel$slopeParam_Estimate,
    midPoint = sigmoidalModel$midPoint_Estimate,
    h0 = sigmoidalModel$h0_Estimate
  )


  lack_of_fit_2<-reps*sum((sigmoid_fitted_unique-group_summary$average)^2)


  lack_of_fit_df<- length(group_summary$time)-4 
  pure_error_df<- length(time)-length(group_summary$time)

  lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat<-(lack_of_fit_2/lack_of_fit_df)/(pure_error/pure_error_df)
  lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<-pf(lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat,lack_of_fit_df,pure_error_df, lower.tail=FALSE)




if(lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<0.05){
  reject_sigmoid<-1
}
       sigmoidalModel.AIC<-sigmoidalModel$AIC
}

else{
  maximum_Estimate<-NA
slopeParam_Estimate<-NA
midPoint_Estimate<-NA
h0_Estimate<-NA
Flat_stat<-NA
F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value<-NA
sigmoidalModel.AIC<-NA
lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat<-NA
lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<-NA
reject_sigmoid<-1
}

if(!is.null(doubleSigmoidalModel)){
ds_fitted_values<-doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = dataInput$time,
    maximum = doubleSigmoidalModel$maximum_y,

    slope1Param =
      doubleSigmoidalModel$slope1Param_Estimate,

    midPoint1Param =
      doubleSigmoidalModel$midPoint1Param_Estimate,

    slope2Param=doubleSigmoidalModel$slope2Param_Estimate,

    midPointDistanceParam = doubleSigmoidalModel$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate,

    finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio=doubleSigmoidalModel$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate,

ds_residuals<-dataInput$intensity-ds_fitted_values

ds_df<-length(time)-7

flat_line<-mean(dataInput$intensity)

flat_residuals<-dataInput$intensity-flat_line

flat_df<-length(time)-1

Flat_ds_stat<-(((sum(flat_residuals^2)-sum(ds_residuals^2)))/(flat_df-ds_df))/(sum(ds_residuals^2)/ds_df)
  

F_Flat_ds_p_value<-pf(Flat_ds_stat,flat_df-ds_df,ds_df,lower.tail=FALSE)


if(F_Flat_ds_p_value>0.01){
  reject_double<-1
}

# Second F-test

total_error_ds<-sum(ds_residuals^2)

avg_at_time_point_ds<- data.frame(dataInput)|>
                        group_by(time)|>
                        mutate(average=mean(intensity))

pure_error_ds<-sum(ave(
    dataInput$intensity,
    dataInput$time,
    FUN = function(x) (x - mean(x))^2))


  ds_fitted_unique <- doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = group_summary$time,
    maximum = doubleSigmoidalModel$maximum_Estimate,
    slope1Param = doubleSigmoidalModel$slope1Param_Estimate,
    midPoint1Param = doubleSigmoidalModel$midPoint1Param_Estimate,
    slope2Param = doubleSigmoidalModel$slope2Param_Estimate,
    midPointDistanceParam = doubleSigmoidalModel$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate,
    finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio = doubleSigmoidalModel$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate,
    h0 = doubleSigmoidalModel$h0_Estimate
  )


  lack_of_fit_2_ds<-reps*sum((ds_fitted_unique-group_summary$average)^2)

  lack_of_fit_df_ds<-length(group_summary$time)-7
  pure_error_df_ds<-length(time)-length(group_summary$time)

  lack_of_fit_ds_stat<-(lack_of_fit_2_ds/lack_of_fit_df_ds)/(pure_error_ds/ pure_error_df_ds)
  lack_of_fit_ds_p_value <- pf(lack_of_fit_ds_stat, lack_of_fit_df_ds, pure_error_df_ds, lower.tail = FALSE)


if(lack_of_fit_ds_p_value<0.05){
  reject_double<-1
}
doubleSigmoidalModel.AIC<-doubleSigmoidalModel$AIC

}

else{
Flat_ds_stat<-NA
F_Flat_ds_p_value<-NA
lack_of_fit_ds_stat<-NA
lack_of_fit_ds_p_value<-NA
doubleSigmoidalModel.AIC<-NA
reject_double<-1  
}




return(data.frame(time_param,reps,noise_level,
Flat_stat,
F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value,
Flat_ds_stat,
F_Flat_ds_p_value,
sigmoidalModel.AIC,
lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat,
lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value,
lack_of_fit_ds_stat,
lack_of_fit_ds_p_value,
doubleSigmoidalModel.AIC,reject_sigmoid,reject_double))}

```

## 1. Double Sigmoidal

Generating data from double sigmoidal models with many different parameter combinations.

```{r}
simulation<-function(){
results<-expand_grid(time_param=c(15,20,30),reps=c(3,5,7),
                     noise_level=c(100,250,500,1000),
                     max=1930,
                     slope1Param=c(0.03,0.05),
                     midPoint1Param=c(100,150),
                     slope2Param=c(0.01,0.03),
                     midPointDistanceParam=c(80,120),
                     finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio=c(0.3,0.6),
                     h0=700)|> 
pmap(F_test_double)|> list_rbind()
return(data.frame(results))
}
```

```{r}
tic()
set.seed(106)
plan(multisession,workers=50)
repeats<-100
final_results_106<-future_map(1:repeats,~simulation(),.options = furrr_options(seed=TRUE))|> list_rbind()
toc()
```

```{r}
final_results_106$reject_sigmoid_test_1<-ifelse(final_results_106$F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value>0.01,1,0)
final_results_106$reject_ds_test_1<-ifelse(final_results_106$F_Flat_ds_p_value>0.01,1,0)
final_results_106$reject_sigmoid_test_2<-ifelse(final_results_106$lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<0.05,1,0)
final_results_106$reject_ds_test_2<-ifelse(final_results_106$lack_of_fit_ds_p_value<0.05,1,0)
final_results_106$reject_sigmoid<-ifelse(final_results_106$reject_sigmoid_test_1==1|final_results_106$reject_sigmoid_test_2==1,1,0)
final_results_106$reject_double<-ifelse(final_results_106$reject_ds_test_1==1|final_results_106$reject_ds_test_2==1,1,0)

final_results_106<-na.omit(final_results_106)
totals_106<-data.frame(reject_sigmoid=
                       final_results_106|>
                       filter(reject_sigmoid==1)|>
                       nrow()/nrow(final_results_106),
                     
                     reject_double=final_results_106|>
                       filter(reject_double==1)|>
                       nrow()/nrow(final_results_106),
                     
                     AIC_sigmoid_reject=final_results_106|>
                       filter(sigmoidalModel.AIC>-10)|>
                       nrow()/nrow(final_results_106),
                     
                     AIC_double_reject=final_results_106|>
                       filter(doubleSigmoidalModel.AIC>-10)|>
                       nrow()/nrow(final_results_106),
                     
                     sigmoid_step1_reject=final_results_106|>
                       filter(reject_sigmoid_test_1==1)|>
                       nrow()/nrow(final_results_106),
                     
                     sigmoid_step2_reject=final_results_106|>
                       filter(reject_sigmoid_test_2==1)|>
                       nrow()/nrow(final_results_106),
                     
                     ds_step1_reject=final_results_106|>
                       filter(reject_ds_test_1==1)|>
                       nrow()/nrow(final_results_106),
                     
                     ds_step2_reject=final_results_106|>
                       filter(reject_ds_test_2==1)|>
                       nrow()/nrow(final_results_106)
)


summary_table_106<-final_results_106|>
  mutate(AIC_sigmoid_reject=ifelse(final_results_106$sigmoidalModel.AIC>-10,1,0),AIC_double_reject=ifelse(final_results_106$doubleSigmoidalModel.AIC>-10,1,0))|>
  group_by(noise_level,reps,time_param)|>
  summarize(reject_sigmoid=mean(reject_sigmoid),AIC_sigmoid_reject=mean(AIC_sigmoid_reject),
            reject_double=mean(reject_double), AIC_double_reject=mean(AIC_double_reject))


```

```{r}
double<-pivot_longer(summary_table_106,cols=c(reject_double,AIC_double_reject),names_to="test",values_to="rejection_rate")
ggplot(double,aes(x=reps,y=rejection_rate,color=test))+
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(width=1.2))+
  labs(title='generation=double sigmoid, rejection_rate=double_sigmoid')+
  theme_minimal()+
  
 
  facet_grid(time_param~noise_level,labeller=labeller(noise_level=c('100'= 'Noise 100','250'= 'Noise 250','500'='Noise 500','1000'= 'Noise 1000'),time_param=c('15'='21 Time Points','20'='16 Time Points','30'='11 Time Points')))
```

```{r}

ggplot(double_2,aes(x=reps,y=rejection_rate,color=test))+
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(width=1.2))+
  labs(title='generation=double sigmoid, rejection_rate=sigmoid')+
  theme_minimal()+
  
 
  facet_grid(time_param~noise_level,labeller=labeller(noise_level=c('100'= 'Noise 100','250'= 'Noise 250','500'='Noise 500','1000'= 'Noise 1000'),time_param=c('15'='21 Time Points','20'='16 Time Points','30'='11 Time Points')))
```

## 2. Sigmoid simulation

Generating data from sigmoidal models with many different parameter combinations.

```{r}
simulation<-function(){
results<-expand_grid(time_param=c(15,20,30),reps=c(3,5,7),
                     noise_level=c(50,100,200,300,400,500),
                      max=c(1930),
                      slopeParam=c(0.01,0.03,0.05),
                      midpoint=c(40,80,160,200),
                      h0=1500)|> 
pmap(F_test_single)|> list_rbind()
return(data.frame(results))}
```

## 3. Quadratic Simulation

simulation<-function(){
results<-expand_grid(time_param=c(15,20,30),reps=c(3,5,7),
                     noise_level=c(1000,5000,10000,20000),
                     )|> 
pmap(F_test_quadratic)|> list_rbind()
return(data.frame(results))}
